name: 哲学
observation: 构图、暖光和器物合适；大理石、水面与桌面略像静物渲染。
direction: 保持4:3与既有构图、配色，只在确需时轻加强笔触；不改成统一金色滤镜。
preserveCue: 书卷与几何器物；阅读、推理与世界的关联
reviewMethod: 总览逐张对照 + 原尺寸复核
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Edit Image 1, the artwork itself. Produce ONE finished background image, no border, no panel, no caption. Preserve the whole composition, camera framing, subject identities, characteristic objects, cultural architecture, time period, main gestures and narrative relationships. This is a PAINTING-MEDIUM CORRECTION, not merely an aspect-ratio repair. The source is too photographic / CGI. Repaint forms themselves, do not retain photo materials under a texture overlay. Hand-painted strokes must be visible at ordinary viewing size: directional loaded brush marks, translucent glazing and dry scumbling, broken color, selective impasto highlights, and deliberate lost-and-found edges. Retain rich legible details in focal objects and faces, but group distant buildings/foliage into painterly masses. Cinematic composition and purposeful key light, layered depth, controlled cool-warm relationships. No universal orange sunset grading. Do not blur the entire image, do not add a canvas/noise filter, do not use photoreal skin, lens bokeh, plastic 3D or video-game sharpness. No new figures, no new conceptual diagrams, no large lettering or labels. Preserve meaningful small inscriptions already physically present on source objects. Keep coherent hands and anatomy. 4:3 landscape, preserve the folio image ratio.
Intensity: Restrained but clearly visible refinement: keep the already-good lighting, palette, atmosphere and composition; strengthen painterly rendering only where materials remain photographic or CGI. Do not turn it into heavy coarse impasto.
Subject: 哲学
Specific issue to correct: 构图、暖光和器物合适；大理石、水面与桌面略像静物渲染。
Art direction: 保持4:3与既有构图、配色，只在确需时轻加强笔触；不改成统一金色滤镜。 Museum-quality hand-painted oil painting, NOT a photograph of actors or architecture. Painted atmosphere rather than digital lens effects.
Content that MUST remain recognizable: 书卷与几何器物；阅读、推理与世界的关联
visualReview: 逐张视觉审阅通过：可见绘画笔触、色层与软硬边缘；原有场景、关键人物动作及辨识器物保留，无明显新增肢体或无关元素。
